_comment: Meanings of test categories in repositories that name test files test-<category>-<function>.R (dsBaseClient, dsBase). Shown to Claude when it picks the category of a new test. Categories a repository uses but that are not listed here reach Claude as their abbreviation, with the repository's existing files as examples. A repository's own config/test-categories.json replaces this file.

categories.arg: Argument checks: the errors and messages for missing, wrongly typed or invalid arguments.
categories.smk: Smoke tests: the function runs on the standard test data and returns results of the expected structure and values.
categories.disc: Disclosure checks: results that would be disclosive are blocked, or return the expected error or notice.
categories.discctrl: Disclosure control: behaviour under the disclosure settings (e.g. nfilter thresholds) on the server.
categories.math: Mathematical properties: results agree with the same computation done locally in R, or with known identities.
categories.expt: Expected results: values compared with known reference results.
categories.perf: Performance: how fast repeated calls run, compared with reference rates.
categories.datachk: Data checks: the structure and content of the test datasets themselves.
